description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division,  Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720005
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in the Siyambalanduwa area. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
